Refund & Cancellation

Last updated: 20 October 2026

Current payment status

Online checkout is not yet available. No charge is made by clicking an upgrade button. The payment, cancellation and refund provisions below apply when paid purchases become available.

Free plan and trial.

The Free plan costs nothing. The Pro trial (currently 7 days) requires a credit card and ends automatically unless you choose a paid plan.

Cancelling Pro.

You can cancel Pro at any time in Settings, Billing. You keep Pro until the end of the period you already paid for, then your account returns to the Free plan. Your existing records are never deleted when you change plan.

Refunds on Pro.

If you are charged for a new monthly period by mistake, or you did not use the Service in that period, contact dailyledger001@gmail.com within [REFUND WINDOW IN DAYS] days of the charge and we will refund it. We do not refund partial months already used.

Refunds on Lifetime.

You may request a full refund within [REFUND WINDOW IN DAYS] days of purchase, no questions asked. After that, Lifetime is non-refundable, except where the law requires otherwise or where we permanently discontinue the Service as described in the Terms.

Legal rights.

Nothing here limits any refund right you have under the consumer law of your country.

How to ask.

Email dailyledger001@gmail.com with the email on your account and the date of the charge. We aim to answer within [2] business days. Approved refunds go back to the original payment method and may take several days to appear. Payment processing is handled by our payment provider, whose own policies may also apply.
